text_block_list.name: Zephyr Fan A
text_block_list.text: Zephyr! Yamanin Zephyyyrrr!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr Fan A
text_block_list.text: That was a great race! You ran so well! I can't wait to see your next performance!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Zephyr Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wait! H-huh?! J-just now... What the?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr achieves fantastic
results in both
the New Zealand Trophy
and the Aoi Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The world is starting to see her for the
brilliant
rising talent she is... It seems the
time has come
for her to make her move.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So then, as we discussed before...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we're deciding on our upcoming goals,
the
Sprinters Stakes in September would
probably be
a good choice.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Let's make our next goal
the
Sprinters Stakes, then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I saw it. The day after the Aoi
Stakes,
at the Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I saw Teio's advent as the next legend,
the
moment she became the dawn wind,
heralding the
birth of an undefeated
Double Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And when I did, I felt my spirit
overflowing,
swirling into a maelstrom.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I, too... must win.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
At the Sprinters Stakes, I will claim
victory
without fail.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by her relationship with
Tokai Teio,
Yamanin Zephyr is brimming
with motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has more than enough innate talent,
and with
summer camp coming up, we
should have ample
time to properly
prepare.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You look like a tumbleweed caught in
the wind...
Is something bothering you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This obviously isn't something I should
hide from
her. I nod hesitantly, then
explain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll be up against senior-year runners,
fearsome
champions who are rocking the
sprint and mile
circuits as we speak.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The seniors...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Tell me of the storms that await.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I know exactly what I have to do on the
turf—I
simply have to become the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Being able to focus on that alone is a
most
auspicious updraft... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back when she debuted, Yamanin
Zephyr hardly
paid those around her any
mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recently, though, her connection with
Tokai Teio
has greatly expanded her
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And soon, her gaze will be fixed on two
giant
walls looming ahead of her.
